coverage_note: Duval independent district comparison, 2024–25. All 150 audited grade-school profiles are searchable with individual February income; 146 Math, ELA and Combined results enter separate fixed district models. Four profiles have no published achievement and retain missing results. Native whole-percent FAST PM3, BEST/Access EOC and eligible FAA achievement retains full-year, home-zoned, ELL and exemption rules; Datafolio and percent-tested participation remain separate. February income, Fall/CCD enrollment and accountable assessment dates/populations differ. The source retains 211 CCD records, 61 outside the released scope, and native-only John Love records without an inferred CCD identity; enrollment differences do not establish their causes. Valid-score counts and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide. Admissions, provider roles, programs, coordinates and boundaries remain unaudited; one year only.

methodology.summary: Duval independent FAST/BEST/FAA School Grades grade-school models with individual February income; valid-score counts and ten-valid-scored floor uncertified, sampling intervals unavailable.
details: Duval independent 2024–25 grade-school district models use exact NCES LEA 1200480 / FL-16 / FDOE 16 identities. All 150 audited pure lower profiles with positive or protected Fall grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12 remain searchable. Original whole-percent School Grades Math and ELA achievement supports 146 schools in each separate Math, ELA and independently fitted Combined model; four profiles retain missing achievement. Same-year individual February lunch-status counts use their own school denominator. Published accountable FAST PM3, BEST/Access EOC and eligible FAA achievement retains full-year, home-zoned, ELL and exemption rules; Datafolio and percent-tested participation remain separate. High, mixed, primary, closed and unmatched scopes remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score denominators and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.

Three separate unweighted OLS fits reproduce all 438 audited results and explicit deleted fits. Combined independently fits the equal mean of original Math and ELA rates, with its own residual scale and studentization. Equal cohorts permit coefficient linearity but never averaging studentized scores. Filters never refit models. Associations do not establish causal effectiveness or overall quality.

School Grades publishes whole percentages proficient at Level 3 or above. FAST PM3 ELA, FAST/BEST/Access Math and eligible FAA performance retain original course, full-year/home-zoned accountability, ELL and exemption rules. Below-grade-3 pupils testing above grade may enter native ELA achievement. Datafolio participation belongs only to percent tested. Component percentages are not averaged or rebuilt from counts.

2024–25 Final Survey 3 February PK–12 school individual eligibility: original free lunch D/F plus reduced-price 3/E plus direct-certification C/R counts divided by that school’s own reported denominator. Provision 2 code 4 must be explicitly zero. District option 6/9 conversions to C/D are already required by the original data element. Federal funding multiplier columns, School Grades economic percentages, universal meal availability, enrollment substitutions and another-year income are not used. CEP individual identification coverage remains unknown; this is an economic disadvantage proxy.

February income and Fall membership use different dates and all school grades. CCD district enrollment 130,054 exceeds the operational school sum 129,932 by 122. Native-only John Love has Fall PK 122 and February denominator 132; that equality does not prove the cause or establish a CCD identity.

School Grades provides no verified valid-score denominators. Its at-least-ten-eligible component rule does not certify ten valid-scored students. February income denominators, Fall/CCD enrollment, percent tested, participation and the federal 95%-rule never substitute for valid-score counts. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null; sampling intervals are unavailable. Studentization uses the deleted-school residual scale and N−3 degrees of freedom; it supplies no enrollment adjustment or shrinkage. Protected counts and missing achievement remain unavailable, never zero.

Full and all 438 deleted designs have rank two and finite positive scales. Largest deleted prediction changes over observed incomes: Math 1.685493; ELA 1.114023; Combined 1.331325 percentage points. All 30 eligible charters, Tiger’s 100% individual income and influential Seaside members remain included. Diagnostic flags never exclude a school or clamp predictions.

The complete source retains 2,495 original records, 59,985 typed cells, original headers, notes and primary definitions. Compact source references preserve exact table, worksheet, row and column evidence. Historical audit approvals remain false; only the separately validated grade-school contract is released.

Four profiles missing published Math and ELA remain searchable. High, mixed, primary, closed and unmatched records remain outside the 150 released profiles. Programs are Unclassified; admissions, provider roles, coordinates and boundaries remain unknown. One year only; incompatible thresholds and income definitions cannot produce a common national ranking.
